## M42 / v4 — timestamp-indexed visual evidence

Each tile has a small lower-left label reading “M42 / v4 / [time].00 seconds” and a dark bottom strip labelled “[time].000 seconds.” No player controls, focus indicators, ON AIR indicators, or speaker tiles are visible.

| Timestamp | Visible content |
|---|---|
| **32.000 seconds** | Muted purple background; “MUSEUM” at upper left. A cream arch joins two thick vertical cream posts. Above the arch are dark navy circular lamps labelled “L” and “R”; neither is yellow. Centered beneath the arch: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”. Bottom text: “CALIBRATION / FIRST”. |
| **34.000 seconds** | Purple background; upper-left “MUSEUM”. Cream arch and two cream posts, with dark navy “L” and “R” circular lamps above; neither is yellow. “A NEW PERSPECTIVE” beneath the arch; “CALIBRATION / FIRST” near the bottom. |
| **36.000 seconds** | Purple background; upper-left “MUSEUM”. Cream arch between thick cream posts. Both circular lamps, “L” on the left and “R” on the right, are dark navy. Text: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE” and, below, “CALIBRATION / FIRST”. |
| **38.000 seconds** | Purple background with “MUSEUM” at upper left. Three cream geometric motifs across the center: two complete upright rectangular outlines, each containing a cream circle; a third outline open on its right, containing a circle with its right side cut flat; a separate thin cream vertical line stands to its right. No calibration text or labelled lamps visible. |
| **40.000 seconds** | Purple background and upper-left “MUSEUM”. Two complete cream rectangular outlines with cream circles inside, followed by a right-open rectangular outline containing a right-truncated circle and a separate thin vertical cream line. No calibration text or labelled lamps visible. |
| **42.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. A large dark navy rounded rectangle occupies the central/lower area. Its light text reads, top to bottom: “DAY / VISIT”, “city.example.org”, “Address pending update”. |
| **44.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Central dark navy rounded panel with three lines: “DAY / VISIT”, “city.example.org”, “Address pending update”. |
| **46.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Dark navy rounded rectangle centered below, containing “DAY / VISIT”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”. |
| **48.000 seconds** | Purple background; upper-left “MUSEUM”. Cream arch and two cream vertical posts. Left circular lamp is bright yellow and labelled “L”; right circular lamp is dark navy and labelled “R”. Text beneath the arch: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”. Bottom: “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. |
| **50.000 seconds** | Purple background; upper-left “MUSEUM”. Cream arch and posts. Left “L” lamp is dark navy; right “R” lamp is bright yellow. Text: “A NEW PERSPECTIVE”; bottom: “CALIBRATION / SECOND”. |
| **52.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Large stylized sailboat: cream trapezoidal hull, thin cream vertical mast, and mustard-yellow triangular sail to the mast’s left. Beneath it, exact text: “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **54.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream-hulled sailboat with a thin cream mast and mustard-yellow triangular sail on its left. Caption: “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **56.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Stylized cream trapezoidal boat hull, cream vertical mast, and mustard-yellow triangular sail to the left. Caption: “Find a new stroy in your city.” |
| **58.000 seconds** | Near-black background with the light uppercase word “TAIL” near the center. No “MUSEUM”, boat, calibration lamps, or other main graphic visible. |
